verses.text: Haxo Jesús ix b'at t'a tzalan Olivo.
Wanxo sakb'i, ix k'ochxi t'a yol yamak'il templo chi'. Ayik ix k'och ta', masanil heb' anima ix k'och yet'ok. Ix em k'ojan, ix sk'ayb'an heb'.

Haxo heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh fariseo ix ik'ankot jun ix ix t'a Jesús, ix yamchaj ix yuj heb' winh ayik wan smulan ix. Ix ak'jioch ix yuj heb' winh t'a yichanh Jesús yet' heb' ayek' yet'ok.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ix ix tik, wan smulan ix ayik ix yamchaj ix ku'uj.
Ha ley Moisés tz'alani, tato ay junok ix ix sk'ulan icha tik, yowalil sjulk'enajcham ix. Xal ach, ¿tas xa chi? xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Palta tonhej stz'ak sk'anb'ej heb' winh, yik syil heb' winh tas syal Jesús chi', yujto snib'ej heb' winh yak'anoch t'a yib'anh. Palta tonhej ix em nhojan, wan stz'ib'an yet' yiximal sk'ab' t'a sat lu'um.

Ix sk'anb'anxi heb' winh t'ay: --¿Tas xa chi yuj jun tik jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix k'e k'elan, ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Tato ay junok ex malaj jab'ok he mul, b'ab'laj julejekoch k'e'en t'a ix, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi', ix emxi nhojan, ix stz'ib'anxiem juntzanhxo tas t'a sat lu'um chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun tik heb' winh, ix laj sna'an sb'a junjun heb' winh, aynhej smul heb' winh. Yuj chi' junjunal ix laj b'at heb' winh. Ha heb' winh ichamtak winak ix b'ab'laj b'ati, haxo heb' winh kelemtak, tzak'anto ix laj b'at heb' winh. Haxonhej Jesús ix kan sch'okoj b'aj linhanek' jun ix ix chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e k'elan Jesús chi', ix yilani sch'okojxonhej ix ayek'i. Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a ix: --Ach ix, ¿b'aj ay heb' winh wan yak'anoch chi' t'a ib'anh? ¿Tom malaj junok heb' winh tz'ak'anoch t'a ib'anh? xchi t'a ix.
--Ma'ay Mamin, manhxalaj heb' winh, xchi ix. --Hanhejtona' in, malaj tas swak'och t'a ib'anh. Yuj chi' ixik. Manhxo ach mulan junelxo, xchi Jesús chi' t'a ix.]

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' anima: --Ha in tik, icha sakil k'inal waj t'a heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an wu'uj, ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ay. Yuj jun sakil k'inal chi', ol scha sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Manhxo ol b'eyek' t'a k'ik' k'inal, xchi Jesús.
Haxo heb' winh fariseo ix halan t'ay: --Ha ach tik, yolnhej ik tzala' to ay opisio. Yuj chi' malaj yelk'och jab' ik tzal chi', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Wach'chom munil swala' to ay wopisio, palta toton yel swala', yujto a in tik wojtak b'aj kotnak in. Hanhejtona', wojtak b'ajtil ol in k'ochxok. Ha exxo tik, manh eyojtakok b'aj kotnak in, hanhejtona' manh eyojtakok b'aj ol in k'ochpaxok.
Ha ex tik, tonhej tze komon ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima t'a elanhchamel. Xal in, malaj mach tzin ch'olb'itej yaji.

Palta k'inalok tato a in tzin ch'olb'itej yaj junok anima, tojolnhej swutej in ch'olb'itan yaji. Yujto manhok innhej tzin ch'olb'itej yaji, yujto a in Mam chekjinak in koti, a sch'olb'itan pax wet'ok.
Ha jun ley aykan t'ayonh, a tz'alani: Tato ay chawanhok testigo lajan syutej yalani, yowalil sko cha kab' tas syal heb'.
Palta ina ay chawanh testigo tz'alan wu'uj. Ha in ton tik testigo in. Testigo pax in Mam wet'ok, haton chekjinak in koti, xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Palta ¿b'ajtil ay a Mam chi'? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Yuj chi' ix yalanpax t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, manh eyojtakok mach in. Manh eyojtakok pax in Mam chi'. Oktom tzin eyojtakejeli mach in, yik ol eyojtakej pax in Mam chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ha t'a yol yamak'il templo t'a slak'anil jun chalab' ofrenda, hata' ix yal juntzanh chi' Jesús. Hata' ix k'ayb'aj heb' anima yuj. Malaj junok mach ix yamani, yujto manto k'och stiempo'al schami.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Ha in tik ol in b'atok. Ha exxo tik ol in he sayek'i, palta ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Manh ol yal he komon k'och b'aj ol in k'och chi', xchi t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix laj yal heb' winh aj Judea chi': --Tekan ol smilcham sb'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh to max yal ko k'och b'aj ol k'och winh chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex tik, aj sat lu'um ex, yujto yik ex yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Xal in tik, manh in yikok yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yujto aj satcha'anh in.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex, t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok. Tato max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol to Ha In Ton Tik, ha t'a skal he mul ol ex chamok, xchi.
--¿Mach ach jun? xchi heb' winh t'ay. Palta ina walnakxo t'ayex t'a yalanhtaxo, mach in.
Tzijtumto tas ol wal eyu'uj yet' ex in ch'olb'itani. Ha jun chekjinak in koti, te yel syala'. Ha tas yalnakkan t'ayin, anhej chi' swal t'ayex a ex ayex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Palta max nachajel yuj heb' winh tato a ko Mam Dios wan yalani.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb' winh: --Hato yik ol in he t'unhb'ank'e a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, hato ta' ol nachajel eyu'uj to Ha In Toni. Hata' ol nachajel eyu'uj to malaj tas munil tzin k'ulej in ch'okoj. Anhej juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yalnak in Mam t'ayin, anhej swala'.
Ha Dios in chekankoti, ay paxoch wet'ok. Max in yaktejkan in ch'okoj, yujto anhej tas snib'ej tzin k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ayik ix yalan juntzanh chi' Jesús, tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch sk'o'ol t'ay.
Haxo ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' israel ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol: --Tato masanil tiempo tzeyak'och he pensar t'a in lolonel, yelton wal in k'ayb'um ex.
Tato icha chi', ol eyojtakejel slolonel Dios te yel. Yuj jun lolonel yel chi', ol ex el t'a libre, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta ix yalanxi heb' t'ay: --Ha onh tik yinhtil onh pax Abraham het'ok. Malaj junelok ix onh och schekab'ok junok anima. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to ol onh el t'a libre? xchi heb'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a mach hanheja' sk'ulan chukal, chekab' yaj t'a chukal chi'.
K'inalok ay junok schekab' junok anima tikne'ik, max yal skajnaj yet' jun anima chi' t'a junelnhej. Palta a junok yuninal jun anima chi', wal yel yuninal yaj t'a junelnhej.
Yuj chi' tato a in tzex wak'el t'a libre, wal yel libre tzex ajkani, yujto yuninal in Dios.
Ha in tik, wojtakxo to yinhtil ex kan winhaj Abraham chi' wet'ok. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok yujto a tas swala' malaj tz'och t'ayex.
Ha tas wilnak t'a in Mam, a swal t'ayex. Ha exxo tik, ch'ok jun he mam wan he k'anab'ajan tas syal t'ayex, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Palta a winhaj Abraham chi' ko mam yaj winh, xchi heb' t'ay. --Oktom wal yel yinhtil ex winh, tato icha chi', tzam he k'anab'ajej icha sk'ulejnak winh.
Ha juntzanh tas yel yalnakkan Dios t'ayin, anhej swal t'ayex. Palta ina he gana tzin he milchamok. Manh ichokta' ix yutej sb'a winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha ex tik, a tas sk'ulej jun he mam tze k'anab'ajej, xchi Jesús t'a heb'. --Palta a onh tik, manh onh mitz'uninoklaj. Junnhej ko Mam, haton Dios, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Oktom yel to yuninal ex Dios chi'. Tato icha chi' tzam in he xajanej, yujto a in tik t'a Dios kotnak in, in ja t'a tik. Manh yolok wik in jawi, yujto ha Dios chekjinak in koti.
¿Tas yuj max nachajel eyu'uj tas swal t'ayex? Tekan malaj he gana tze cha eyab' tas swal tik.

Ha ex tik, a jun he mam, haton winh diablo. Yuj chi', anhej t'a winh tzeyak'och he pensar. Anhej tas snib'ej winh tze k'ulej. Yiktax ix b'oji yol yib'anhk'inal tik, milumcham anima winh. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok tas yel t'a winh, yujto anhej es snib'ej winh. Ayik syesan winh, t'a spensar winh skoti, yujto esalwum winh. Ha t'a winh pitzwinakkot es chi'.
Ha inxo tik, yujto a juntzanh tas te yel swal t'ayex, yuj chi' max he cha eyab'i.
¿Mach junok ex syal he ch'oxanel jab'ok in mul? Te yel juntzanh tas swal t'ayex tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj max he cha eyab'i?
Ha heb' yik Dios, syak'och schikin heb' t'a slolonel. Palta a exxo tik, manh ex yikok Dios, yuj chi' max yal he k'ol tzeyak'och he chikin t'ay, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' winh aj Judea chi' t'ay: --Tekan yel skala' to aj Samaria ach, tekan to ayoch junok enemigo t'ayach, xchi heb' t'ay.
--Ma'ay, malaj junok enemigo ayoch t'ayin. Wan in k'anab'ajan tas syal in Mam. Palta a ex tik, tonhej tzex b'uchwaj t'ayin.
Ha in tik, malaj in gana ay welk'ochi. Palta ay junxo tz'alani to ay welk'och t'a sat. Ha jun chi sch'olb'itani mach yel syala'.
Wal yel swal t'ayex, a heb' sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'inh ol cham heb', xchi t'a heb' winh.

--Ha tikne'ik skojtakejeli to ayoch enemigo t'ayach. Ha winhaj Abraham yet' jantaknhej heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka', chamnakxo heb' smasanil. Ha hachxo tik tzala': Tato ay mach sk'anab'ajan tas swala', malaj b'ak'inh ol chamok, niwanok xa chi.
¿Tom ek'to elk'och t'a yichanh winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham chi'? Ina chamnak winh, chamnakxo pax heb' schekab' Dios chi', ¿mach ach a na'an tikne'ik? xchi heb' winh t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi t'a heb' winh: --Tato munil swik'cha'anh in b'a, malaj welk'ochi. Palta a in Mam tz'alani to ay welk'ochi. Ha in Mam chi' tzeyaloch he Diosalok,

palta niwanok tzeyal icha chi', yujto manh eyojtakok Dios chi'. Ha in tik, wojtak sik'lab'il. K'inalok swala' to manh wojtakok, swesej icha ex tik. Palta yel wojtak, yujto a tas syala', a tzin k'anab'ajejnhej.
Ha winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham chi', tzalajnak winh yujto aljinak t'a winh to ol yil winh in jawi. Ix yilan winh, yuj chi' ix te tzalaj winh, xchi t'a heb' winh.
--¿Tom ilnakto winhaj Abraham chi'? Ina manto ach k'och t'a 50 ab'il, xchi heb' winh t'ay.
--Wal yel swal t'ayex, ayik manto alji winhaj Abraham chi', ayintaxonek'i, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ix laj sik'ank'e k'e'en k'e'en heb' winh yik sjulanoch k'e'en heb' winh t'ay. Ix sk'ub'anel sb'a t'a heb' winh, ix elta t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Ix ek'b'at t'a skal heb' winh, ix b'ati.
